subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Late morning, we took a __stroll __along the beach.
solution:
The correct answer is "**saunter**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Stroll**' means to walk leisurely as inclination directs. (टहलना)

 
 
• **Example**- After dinner, they went for a stroll in the park.
 
 
 
• '**Saunter**' means to walk in a slow, relaxed manner, without hurry or effort. (सुस्त ग़ून्धना)
 
 
• **Example**- She sauntered through the streets, enjoying the city's rich architecture.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is 'saunter'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Scamper**' means to run hurriedly or quickly. (झूलना) 
 
• '**Sprint**' means to run at full speed over a short distance. (तेजी से दौड़ना)
 
• '**Jog**' means to run at a steady gentle pace. (धीरे-धीरे दौड़ना)
